description: This Java class defines a custom Spring condition that determines whether a certain loan transaction processor (related to RBI India) is enabled, based on configuration properties.

classes.name: RBIIndiaLoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessorCondition
classes.description: A condition class extending PropertiesCondition, used to check if RBI India-specific transaction processing is enabled in the properties.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Overrides the base method to return true if the RBI India transaction processor is enabled in the configuration properties.
